# Customize the workflow generated by Deploy Now (Symfony)

Path: `.github/workflows/<project>-build.yaml` (workflow v2)

## A. PHP version + extensions

```yaml
      - name: Setup PHP
        uses: shivammathur/setup-php@v2
        with:
          php-version: '8.2'
          extensions: intl, mbstring, mysqli, pdo_mysql, curl, gd, xml, zip
          coverage: none
          tools: composer:v2
```

## B. Composer

```yaml
      - name: Install Composer dependencies
        run: composer install --no-dev --optimize-autoloader --no-interaction --prefer-dist
```

## C. Front-end assets (Webpack Encore)

```yaml
      - name: Setup Node
        uses: actions/setup-node@v4
        with:
          node-version: '20'

      - name: Build assets
        run: |
          npm ci
          npm run build
```

If using Symfony AssetMapper instead of Encore, skip Node entirely.

## D. Do NOT modify

Bottom steps referencing `ionos-deploy-now/template-renderer-action` and `ionos-deploy-now/deploy-to-ionos-action`.

## E. Publish directory env

```yaml
env:
  DEPLOYMENT_FOLDER: ./
```
